# DSH Channels for DeepSeek Harness

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

DSH Channels is an open source **DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin** for team chat, persistent AI mission threads, and channel memory. Chat with people in a shared channel. Mention `@deepseek` to start an agent task or continue its existing DSH Session.

**Mention to Mission:** ordinary messages stay as human chat. Each explicit mention creates or continues a mission with native assistant messages, tools, summaries, and TODO progress.

Working alpha for trusted DSH workspaces. Requires Node.js 24.9 or later and DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`. [Read the Host access boundary](#memory-and-access) before inviting teammates.

[Install](#install) · [Use](#use) · [Trigger rules](#trigger-rules) · [Real screen flow](docs/flow.md) · [Verification evidence](docs/verification.md) · [FAQ](#faq)

![DeepSeek Harness channel chat beside a real AI mission with native TODO progress](docs/media/03-real-mission-todo.png)

## Why use DSH Channels

- Keep team decisions in a shared channel without running an agent for every message.
- Turn an explicit `@deepseek` request into a separate mission thread and native DSH Session.
- Reopen a mission with its assistant history, tool output, summary, and actual TODO progress.
- Give a new mission relevant channel history and earlier mission summaries, within a defined memory limit.

[Walk through the real screens](docs/flow.md) from human chat to a mission, a contextual reply, and memory across Sessions. The screenshots come from real Chromium and the official DeepSeek API.

## Install

The tested DeepSeek Harness revision is `fcc0ad462172522aaf5c93a7b2e01f6b9f0b0159`. Install the package into the DSH Web profile:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/liush2yuxjtu/dsh-channels.git
cd dsh-channels
npm pack --ignore-scripts
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD/dsh-channels-0.1.0.tgz"
dsh web
```

Enable the bundle in DSH's plugin manager. Configure your DeepSeek credential in the Host settings. The browser never receives the model API key. The plugin does not change upstream files.

## Use

1. Open Channels. The first authenticated Host browser creates the owner identity and `general` channel.
2. Send ordinary messages to chat with people. They make no model request.
3. Send `@deepseek` followed by a task. Its mission opens on the right with the native conversation history and tools.
4. Reply normally to leave a team note. Mention `@deepseek` in that thread to continue the same Session.
5. Use **Members and channels** to create a channel or a one-time invitation. A second trusted browser joins with its own name and invitation.
6. Select **Native DSH** to restore the original navigation, composer, Settings, and Plugins. Select **Open DSH Channels** to return.

The sidebar shows mission titles, actual assistant summaries, and progress from native `todo/write` events. It does not infer task completion from prose.

## Trigger rules

| Message | Agent behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `Please review this` | Save a human message |
| `@deepseek review this` | Start a mission |
| `@DeepSeek review this` | Start a mission |
| Mention inside a thread | Continue that mission's Session |
| Ordinary reply inside a thread | Save a team note |
| Inline code, fenced code, quoted lines, email, or `@deepseekish` | No trigger from those occurrences |
| An empty mention | Reject it and keep the draft |

When a valid mention appears outside code or a quotation, the parser keeps the code and quoted material in the task. It removes valid mention tokens and trims surrounding whitespace and punctuation.

## Memory and access

Each prompt includes at most the last 50 messages and 12 saved mission summaries from its own channel, within 24,000 characters. Context carries message and mission IDs. The current thread retains its normal DSH Session history. This is channel-scoped context and saved mission memory, not a global memory system.

The server derives authors from member tokens and checks channel membership on every read, post, invite, and retry. It stores SHA256 hashes of member and invitation tokens. Messages and delivery intent save together before a model prompt. Stable outbox request IDs let DSH deduplicate accepted work after retries.

**Use this release with trusted teammates on a trusted Host.** Plugin member access restricts plugin data. DSH owner browser credentials still grant access to the entire Host and its other Session APIs. A channel invitation does not turn an owner authentication URL into an isolated guest login. Do not share that URL with untrusted users.

Identity tokens and drafts remain in browser local storage. Host messages, invitations, mission bindings, and receipts remain in the DSH storage domain. Deleting browser data loses that browser's member token. There is no account recovery UI in this release.

## FAQ

### Does a normal channel or thread reply run DeepSeek?

Ordinary replies save human messages. Only an explicit valid `@deepseek` mention starts or continues agent execution. Code examples, quoted lines, URLs, and escaped mentions do not trigger it. See the [trigger rules](#trigger-rules).

### Does each mission have its own DSH Session?

Each root mention creates a separate mission and native Session. Mentions inside that mission continue the same Session. The sidebar keeps its title, actual reply summary, and TODO count available between visits.

### What does channel memory include?

The current mission keeps its Session history. New execution also receives the same channel's recent messages and saved mission summaries. It does not scan every Session on the Host. See the [memory limits and access model](#memory-and-access).

### Is DSH Channels a Slack bot?

DSH Channels brings a Slack-style channel and thread workflow into DeepSeek Harness. It runs inside DSH and does not connect to Slack or require a Slack account.

### Can I use this as a public chat service?

This alpha targets trusted teammates who already have access to a trusted DSH Host. Plugin membership limits plugin data. An owner login still controls the wider Host, so it is not an isolated guest account.

## Get help

For a reproducible problem, [report it in GitHub Issues](https://github.com/liush2yuxjtu/dsh-channels/issues). Include your DSH version, Node.js version, expected behavior, and reproduction steps. Keep API keys, owner login URLs, member tokens, and private channel messages out of reports.

See [the full verification report](docs/verification.md) for tested behavior and limits. For related projects, browse [this author's DSH plugins](https://github.com/search?q=user%3Aliush2yuxjtu+topic%3Adsh-plugins&type=repositories) or the [DSH plugin topic](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin).

## Verify

```sh
npm run verify
DSH_SOURCE_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/built/deepseek-harness \
DSH_API_KEY_FILE=/private/path/to/deepseek.key \
npm run verify:live
node scripts/install-hooks.mjs
```

The live test uses the official DeepSeek API and real Chromium. It records API response IDs and token usage. It matches reply text, tool-call IDs and arguments, and TODO updates against persisted DSH events. It checks silent human messages, independent missions, contextual replies, same-channel memory, server access checks, browser reload, mobile navigation, and Native DSH restoration.

`node scripts/cold-restart.mjs` tests two real DSH CLI processes against the same durable storage. The pre-commit hook exports the exact staged tree and runs fresh checks. Missing runtime or credentials fails the commit. Runtime authentication URLs, credentials, and private data stay out of Git.

See [verification evidence](docs/verification.md) and [implementation decisions](WORK.md).

## Limits

The first release stores one bounded workspace document. It supports 100 channels, 200 identities, 10,000 human messages, 2,000 missions, 10,000 delivery receipts, and 1,000 invitations. Reaching a limit refuses new writes without deleting pending work. Export or migrate storage before increasing those limits. It is not intended as a high volume public chat server.

DSH's plugin API is pre-stable. This plugin targets the version above. It adds no telemetry or analytics of its own.

## License

MIT. The test runner and response-provenance checks build on the MIT-licensed [dsh-slack](https://github.com/liush2yuxjtu/dsh-slack) project by the same author.

# DSH Channels 频道协作与任务线程插件

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

DSH Channels 是开源的 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，提供团队频道聊天、独立 AI 任务线程和频道记忆。团队成员正常聊天，需要 Agent 执行时才提及 `@deepseek`。

**Mention to Mission** 将一次明确提及转为任务。每个任务使用独立的原生 DSH Session，保留 Assistant 消息、工具结果、摘要和真实 TODO 进度。普通线程回复只保存为团队留言，再次提及会继续同一个任务。

当前为可信 DSH 工作区内使用的 Working Alpha。需要 Node.js 24.9 或更新版本，以及 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`。邀请成员前先阅读[上下文与权限](#上下文与权限)。

[安装](#安装) · [使用](#使用) · [常见问题](#常见问题) · [完整实机流程，英文界面](docs/flow.md) · [验收证据](docs/verification.md)

## 适用场景

- 将团队决策保存在频道里，普通消息不调用 Agent。
- 用一次 `@deepseek` 明确请求创建任务线程和原生 DSH Session。
- 重新打开任务时，查看既有对话、工具输出、摘要和实际 TODO 进度。
- 让新任务读取本频道的近期消息和已有任务摘要，并限制记忆范围。

[实机流程](docs/flow.md)展示频道聊天、提及创建任务、线程续聊和跨 Session 记忆。素材来自真实 Chromium 和官方 DeepSeek API，界面及示例对话使用英文。

## 安装

需要 Node.js 24.9 或更新版本，以及 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/liush2yuxjtu/dsh-channels.git
cd dsh-channels
npm pack --ignore-scripts
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD/dsh-channels-0.1.0.tgz"
dsh web
```

在 DSH 插件管理器启用该 bundle。在 Host 设置中配置 DeepSeek 凭据。API key 不会传给浏览器。插件不修改 upstream 文件。

## 使用

1. 第一个已登录的 Host 浏览器创建所有者身份和 `general` 频道。
2. 发送普通消息，与团队聊天。普通消息不调用模型。
3. 发送 `@deepseek` 加具体任务。右侧打开独立任务线程。
4. 在线程中普通回复，保存团队留言。提及 `@deepseek`，继续当前任务。
5. 在“成员与频道”创建频道或一次性邀请。第二个可信浏览器可用邀请和自己的名字加入。
6. 点击“原生 DSH”恢复原导航、输入框、设置和插件管理。

代码、引用、email 和 `@deepseekish` 中的提及不会触发 Agent。有效提及之外的代码和引用仍会作为任务材料传入。空任务会被拒绝，并保留输入草稿。

## 上下文与权限

每次任务只读取本频道最近 50 条消息与 12 个任务摘要，最多 24,000 个字符，并保留消息和任务来源 ID。同一任务保留原生 DSH Session 历史。

服务端从成员凭据确定作者。每次读取、发送和重试都检查频道成员权限。消息与投递记录先一起写盘，再调用模型。固定 request ID 防止重试时重复执行已接受的任务。

**此版本用于可信 Host 内的可信团队。** 插件成员权限只约束插件数据。DSH owner 登录凭据仍能访问整个 Host。不要向不可信的人分享 owner 登录链接。频道邀请不等于独立的 Host guest 登录。

成员凭据与草稿保存在浏览器 local storage。频道数据、任务绑定和投递记录保存在 DSH storage domain。清除浏览器数据会丢失该浏览器的成员凭据。此版本没有账号恢复界面。

## 常见问题

### 普通频道消息或线程回复会运行 DeepSeek 吗

普通回复只保存为人类消息。只有有效的显式 `@deepseek` 提及才会执行。代码示例、引用行、URL 和转义提及不会触发。空任务会被拒绝，并保留草稿。

### 每个任务都有独立 Session 吗

频道中的新提及创建独立任务和原生 Session。该任务线程内的提及继续同一个 Session。侧栏保留标题、真实摘要和 TODO 计数。

### 频道记忆包含什么

当前任务保留其 Session 历史。执行时也会获得本频道近期消息和已有任务摘要。插件不会扫描 Host 中的全部 Session。具体范围见[上下文与权限](#上下文与权限)。

### 这是 Slack Bot 吗

DSH Channels 将类似 Slack 的频道与线程工作流放入 DeepSeek Harness。它在 DSH 内运行，不连接 Slack，也不要求 Slack 账号。

### 能用来搭建公开聊天服务吗

此 Alpha 面向已获得可信 DSH Host 访问权限的团队。插件成员权限约束插件数据。Owner 登录仍可控制整个 Host，不是独立的 guest 账号。

## 获取帮助

遇到可复现的问题，可在 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/liush2yuxjtu/dsh-channels/issues) 提供 DSH 版本、Node.js 版本、预期行为和复现步骤。不要提交 API key、Owner 登录链接、成员凭据或私有频道消息。

相关项目可从[本作者的 DSH 插件](https://github.com/search?q=user%3Aliush2yuxjtu+topic%3Adsh-plugins&type=repositories)或 [DSH plugin Topic](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)查找。完整测试范围见[验收报告](docs/verification.md)。

## 验证

```sh
npm run verify
DSH_SOURCE_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/built/deepseek-harness \
DSH_API_KEY_FILE=/private/path/to/deepseek.key \
npm run verify:live
node scripts/install-hooks.mjs
```

最终验收使用真实 Chromium、真实 DeepSeek API 和真实 DSH Session。脚本记录 API 响应 ID 和 token 用量，并逐项核对回复文本、工具调用 ID、参数和 TODO 更新是否与持久化的 DSH 事件一致。冷重启脚本会启动两个独立的真实 DSH CLI 进程。

每次提交前，Git hook 会导出 staged tree 并重新运行真实 API E2E。缺少凭据或验收失败会阻止提交。完整证据见 [verification.md](docs/verification.md)。

## 容量

默认上限为 100 个频道、200 个身份、10,000 条人类消息、2,000 个任务、10,000 条投递记录和 1,000 个邀请。达到上限后拒绝新增，不删除未处理任务。此版本不适合作为高流量公开聊天服务。

MIT License。

# Verification

Working alpha acceptance passed on 2026-11-10. The executable plugin sources match both the real API browser run and the two-process cold restart run.

| Check | Result | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Domain behavior and real disk persistence | 16 tests PASS | `node --test tests/channels.test.mjs` |
| Real Chromium and actual DeepSeek API | 19 checks PASS; 7 official responses | [live.json](evidence/live.json) |
| Normal Host stop and cold restart | 13 checks PASS; two independent processes, two model turns | [cold-restart.json](evidence/cold-restart.json) |
| Native TODO persistence | 2 actual tasks, 1 complete after restart | [cold-restart.json](evidence/cold-restart.json) |
| Browser errors | None | [live.json](evidence/live.json) |
| Independent review | Four release blockers fixed and rechecked; no remaining release blocker | [decisions.tsv](../decisions.tsv) |

## Browser coverage

Human root messages and human thread notes make no model call. An explicit mention creates a native Session. A thread mention continues that exact Session. A new mission recalls same-channel history and saved summaries. Actual outgoing official API request bodies exclude a fact saved in another channel. Server membership checks reject a guessed private channel and forged Session fields. The official Host admission rejects missing cookies and foreign Origins.

The browser deliberately loses one acknowledgement after the real server accepts a mission, reloads the page, and retries the saved draft. The stored request ID prevents a duplicate mission. The test forwards the request to the actual server before dropping its response. It uses no fake model response or replay.

The UI uses the native conversation and tool rendering. Internal channel context enters the model through a scoped, durable context contribution and does not appear as an ordinary user message. Screenshots cover human chat, a mission, a contextual reply, memory across missions, reload, phone navigation, and dark mode. Phone checks click the real controls without forced clicks. Dark mode uses the Host setting and verifies computed colors.

## Cold restart scope

The cold check starts the actual official DSH CLI, saves a human message, runs a real model mission with non-empty native TODOs, stops the Host with SIGTERM, and starts a different process against the same storage. It verifies the same member, channel, messages, Mission, Session, summary, and TODOs. A real followup remembers an unrepeated random word in the same Session.

This checks normal shutdown and cold restart. Abrupt process death during the prompt admission window has not been exercised end to end. The domain tests cover durable pending work, failed writes, retry ordering, and bootstrap acknowledgement recovery.

## Reproduce

Use a built DeepSeek Harness checkout at `fcc0ad462172522aaf5c93a7b2e01f6b9f0b0159` and an existing official API credential. Configure `DSH_SOURCE_ROOT`, `DSH_API_KEY_FILE`, and, if needed, `DSH_CHROMIUM_PATH`. Run `npm run verify`, `npm run verify:live`, and `node scripts/cold-restart.mjs`. The installed Git hook exports the exact staged tree and runs all three checks again before accepting a commit.

Credentials, member tokens, invitations, authentication URLs, and the other channel's test fact are absent from the public evidence. This plugin is for a trusted Host workspace. Plugin membership does not isolate the wider DSH Host.

# DSH Channels: task and installation guide

Reviewed: 2026-11-10. This is first-party product documentation, not independent validation or a ranking claim. Sources: [package metadata](../../package.json), [README](../../README.md), [Chinese README](../../README.zh-CN.md), and [verification](../verification.md). Follow verification evidence for runtime acceptance.

## Add team channels to DeepSeek Harness

DSH Channels is an external DeepSeek Harness plugin for trusted teammates. Use Node.js 24.9 or later and the tested DSH package version 0.2.2-rc.1. Clone this repository, run `npm pack --ignore-scripts`, then run `dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD/dsh-channels-0.1.0.tgz"` from the repository directory. Start `dsh web` and enable the bundle in Plugins. Configure the model credential in Host settings. This command installs the local package; it does not install a Slack bot.

## 安装团队频道

DSH Channels 是 DeepSeek Harness 的外部插件。使用 Node.js 24.9 或更高版本，以及已验证的 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1。克隆本仓库并运行 `npm pack --ignore-scripts`，然后运行 `dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD/dsh-channels-0.1.0.tgz"`。运行 `dsh web`，在 Plugins 中启用插件，并在 Host 设置中配置模型凭据。此安装流程用于可信团队。

## Keep human chat quiet and continue the original task

Only an explicit `@deepseek` mention invokes the Agent. Ordinary messages and ordinary thread replies save human notes and make no model request. A mention in a channel starts a mission thread; a mention in that thread continues the same DSH Session. Native `todo/write` events provide actual TODO progress; a model saying it is done does not mark completion. See the [trigger parser and flow](../../README.md#trigger-rules).

## 重用任务会话

只有显式 `@deepseek` 才触发 Agent。普通消息和普通线程回复只保存人类留言，不调用模型。频道中的 mention 创建任务线程；同一个线程中的 mention 继续同一 DSH Session。原生 `todo/write` 事件提供真实 TODO 进度，不能根据模型文字推测完成状态。

## Check task fit and limits before choosing

| Need | Supported behavior and limit |
| --- | --- |
| Relevant previous context | Each prompt uses at most 50 channel messages and 12 saved mission summaries, within 24,000 characters, from the current channel. Normal Session history remains in that thread. |
| Retry after lost acknowledgement | Stable outbox request IDs let DSH deduplicate accepted work on retry. Reuse the original durable request identity; a new task is not the same retry. |
| Trusted local collaboration | This is a trusted Host tool. Channel membership does not isolate the entire Host. Owner browser credentials still reach wider Host APIs. |
| Keep the model secret at the Host | Configure the API key in Host settings; the browser never receives the model API key. |
| Slack-shaped flow inside DSH | The plugin runs inside DeepSeek Harness and does not connect to Slack. For a bot installed in an existing Slack workspace, choose a product with that integration. |
| Untrusted public tenants | Do not use this release as an isolated public multi-tenant service. A plugin invitation is not a separate Host login. |

These are documented product constraints, not benchmark claims. Passing an offline source check does not prove a search engine has indexed the page or an assistant recommends it.
